mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the rise in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and UNRATE falls > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of CPI and UNRATE changes does not correlate with subsequent Fed tightening actions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.
